updates.new_requirement: Every certifying similarity witness must declare a relation-specific admissible mapping family before pair fitting; mapping expressivity is part of the evidence contract.
Track which observational/interventional/counterfactual or domain-specific probe families remain valid after a lossy abstraction, not only which coordinates were erased.

updates.problem: Similarity conditioned on one QoI does not expose how equivalence changes when the allowed family of distinguishing probes expands.
updates.target: Represent equivalence under explicit nested probe families and test partition-refinement monotonicity under fixed maps/tolerances.
updates.falsifier: If query-family metadata does not reduce false global equivalence or improve discriminator routing on frozen hostile worlds, keep it as explanatory notation rather than runtime state.

updates.problem: A highly expressive learned mapping can manufacture apparent deep similarity or causal abstraction between unrelated systems.
updates.target: Freeze admissible map families, complexity/structural constraints and shuffled/null controls before fitting; compare unrestricted versus capacity-controlled certification.
updates.falsifier: If unrestricted maps do not increase false analogies or vacuous matches on the frozen Round-012 worlds under matched retrieval/model budget, reject extra map-capacity machinery.

updates.problem: Rejected equivalences are currently summarized by broken correspondences but do not always preserve the exact experiment/query that separated the objects.
updates.target: Store immutable distinguishing-probe certificates and reuse them as hostile regressions against successor mappings.
updates.falsifier: If explicit discriminator memory adds no protection beyond existing P- broken-correspondence records on successor/revision tests, deduplicate it into the existing negative-history representation.

updates.problem: Surface or snapshot-equivalent states can have divergent future behavior; equation-shape similarity can likewise hide transition-law differences.
updates.target: For genuinely dynamical objects, compare snapshot/equation similarity against transition-aware behavioral or bisimulation-like local relations without universalizing MDP assumptions.
updates.falsifier: If transition-aware views do not reduce dynamic false merges on frozen worlds, do not add a generic dynamical similarity module.

new_prior_art: projected causal abstraction under lossy representations
nonlinear alignment vacuity in causal abstraction
updates.consequence: Do not claim mapping witnesses, lossy abstraction, bisimulation or abstraction-assisted mapping individually. Attack prior art for the narrower combination of admissible-map contracts, query-family equivalence refinement, immutable distinguishing probes and RAKL authority gating.
